cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was selected as the enzyme of choice, and a maximum of two missed cleavages was permitted.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides from each fraction were enriched using immobilized metal affinity chromatography (Ti4+-IMAC, JK Chemical) following a previously described method with adaptations.

fractionation_method.evidence: For proteomics quantification, the TMT-labeled peptide mixture was fractionated on a nanoEase M/Z Peptide BEH C18 column (300 μm × 150 mm, 1.7 μm; 130 Å, Waters) as previously described with a 128-min gradient (3% buffer B for 14 min, 3% to 8% B for 1 min, 8% to 29% B for 71 min, 29% to 41% B for 12 min, 41% to 100% B for 1 min, 100% B for 8 min, and 100% to 3% B for 1 min followed by 20 min at 3% B).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: The Orbitrap Fusion Lumos was configured with a resolution of 60K for MS1 and 50K for MS2.

ptm.evidence: Variable modifications considered in the search included oxidation (M) and acetylation (protein N-terminus) with phosphorylation (STY) for phosphopeptides.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Sperm samples were lysed using sonication in a lysis buffer composed of 8 M Urea, 1 mM DTT, 75 mM NaCl, and 50 mM Tris (pH 8.2), supplemented with a protease and phosphatase cocktail.
